name: holdings
title: Holdings
description: What is held and what it is worth, as of a date (default today): every account, plus the property, loans and private holdings recorded by hand (a loan is negative). view=global: one row with cash_balance, positions_value and total_value (net worth); it has no per-account columns, so a filter needs another view. sources: per institution. portfolios: per portfolio. accounts: per account with kind, tax wrapper and value. positions: every holding with symbol, quantity and value. Example: {view: "accounts", as_of: "2025-12-31"}.

account.description: Keep rows whose account name, id or nickname contains this (case-insensitive).

asset_class.description: positions only: keep only this asset class (e.g. public_equity, fixed_income, cash, real_estate, crypto).

currency.description: Output currency, e.g. USD or CHF. Default: the configured one.

filter.description: Conditions, all of which hold: ["value > 1000", "date >= 2025-07", "category not in Rent, Groceries"].

limit.description: Most rows to return (default: as many as fit).

max_chars.description: Most characters the result may take (default 16000); the page ends at a row boundary and the last line says how to get the rest.

missing_basis.description: positions only: a missing cost basis is blank (ignore, the default) or counts as 0 (zero); the config's lots.missing_basis sets the default.

search.description: Keep rows with this text in any cell.

sort.description: Column to sort by; "-" for descending. "-value": the main money column, largest first whatever the sign.

source.description: Keep this source id only (e.g. "schwab"); a comma list keeps several.

symbol.description: positions only: keep only holdings whose symbol or name contains this text.

tax_wrapper.description: accounts only: keep only this tax wrapper (e.g. roth_ira, 401k, 529, taxable_joint).

with_cash.description: positions only: also list cash as one row per account and currency.
